title: Job end states come from where the error came from
description: Failures are classified by sniffing error types, and errors that did not come from Postgres reach db.IsAway, so a store failure can be recorded as 'Postgres was away' (cancelled and retried rather than failed with its cause).
acceptanceCriteria: A table test maps error to state: a *net.OpError or io.ErrUnexpectedEOF from the store gives failed with the store named in error; the same types from a pool call give cancelled; a lost lease gives cancelled; a spec whose JSON does not decode is failed and no ffmpeg starts
With a transcode store that refuses connections, PlaybackInfo and the segment answer the documented failure naming the store, not a Postgres wait
db.IsAway is called only on errors from the pool
